findings.note: RotoWire (Oct 9) says all three of Coleman's points have come with the man advantage, where he leads the Wild's second power-play unit. It expects his hot start to fade toward his usual mid-to-high 30s point pace. His power-play role is the main risk to the Under.

ESPN's game log shows 3 points (2 G, 1 A, all on the power play) in 6 October games while averaging about 15:35 of ice time. He was scoreless in 3 of his last 5 listed games, including both games on Oct. 10 and Oct. 12. The Oct. 15 game against St. Louis was not shown.

NHL.com's projected lineup for Oct. 15 had Coleman on Minnesota's second line with Danila Yurov and Maxim Shabanov, a middle-six role. No injury was noted. I found no Oct. 18 lineup, injury report, Columbus matchup info, or published pick on this market.
